types.name: BranchIndicatorState
types.zh: 传给 branch 渲染器的单个缩进格状态。当前节点格负责展开箭头，祖先格可用于连接线；布尔值默认 false、深度默认 0。
types.en: State of an indentation cell passed to a branch renderer. The node cell carries the expansion indicator; ancestor cells can carry connectors. Booleans default to false and depths to 0.

members.name: hasChildren
members.zh: 该格对应节点是否有子节点。
members.en: Whether the represented node has children.

members.name: hasSiblings
members.zh: 该格对应节点下方是否还有同级节点。
members.en: Whether another sibling follows the represented node.

members.name: adjoinsItem
members.zh: 是否为当前行自身的 branch 格；只有此格承载展开箭头。
members.en: Whether this is the row's own branch cell, which carries the expansion indicator.

members.name: isExpanded
members.zh: 对应节点是否展开；有子节点时才有展开含义。
members.en: Whether the represented node is expanded; meaningful for nodes with children.

members.name: cellDepth
members.zh: 该格的绝对层级，0 为顶层，自身格等于 itemDepth。
members.en: Absolute cell level: 0 is top level; the node's own cell equals itemDepth.

members.name: itemDepth
members.zh: 当前绘制行的深度，0 为顶层节点。
members.en: Depth of the row being painted; 0 is top level.

types.name: ColumnGeometry
types.zh: HeaderGeometry 提供的列几何快照。逻辑序号标识模型列，视觉序号表示显示顺序；内容坐标和 viewport 坐标不可混用。
types.en: Column geometry from HeaderGeometry. Logical indexes identify model columns; visual indexes describe display order. Content and viewport coordinates are distinct.

members.name: logicalIndex
members.zh: 模型逻辑列号，初始 -1 表示无效。
members.en: Model column index; initially -1 (invalid).

members.name: visualIndex
members.zh: 视觉顺序中的列号，初始 -1。
members.en: Position in visual order; initially -1.

members.name: contentX
members.zh: 内容坐标中的左边界，初始 0。
members.en: Left boundary in content coordinates; initially 0.

members.name: viewportX
members.zh: viewport 坐标中的左边界，初始 0，随滚动变化。
members.en: Left boundary in viewport coordinates; initially 0; changes with scrolling.

members.name: width
members.zh: 列宽，初始 0；隐藏列为 0。
members.en: Column width; initially 0, also 0 for hidden columns.

members.name: hidden
members.zh: 是否隐藏，初始 false。
members.en: Whether hidden; initially false.

types.name: HeaderGeometry::ResizeSnapshot
types.zh: 列边界按下时的尺寸快照，用于 resizeSectionFromEdge()。通过 resizeSnapshot() 获取，不要手工拼装；结构或可用长度变化会使快照失效。
types.en: Press-time sizing snapshot for resizeSectionFromEdge(). Obtain it with resizeSnapshot() rather than assembling it manually. Structural or extent changes invalidate it.

members.name: sizes
members.zh: 按下时各逻辑 section 的尺寸，初始为空。
members.en: Press-time sizes by logical section; initially empty.

members.name: orderRevision
members.zh: 结构和顺序版本，用于失效检查，初始 0。
members.en: Structure/order revision for invalidation; initially 0.

members.name: fitRevision
members.zh: 填充布局版本，用于失效检查，初始 0。
members.en: Fit-layout revision for invalidation; initially 0.

members.name: extent
members.zh: 捕获时可用总长度，初始 0。
members.en: Available extent at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: minimum
members.zh: 捕获时最小 section 尺寸，初始 0。
members.en: Minimum section size at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: maximum
members.zh: 捕获时最大 section 尺寸，初始 0。
members.en: Maximum section size at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: spacings
members.zh: 捕获时间距数据，初始为空。
members.en: Spacing data at capture time; initially empty.

types.name: EditRequestContext
types.zh: adapter 自行处理 Popup 编辑的定位与生命周期上下文。矩形是未按可见区域裁剪的完整项范围，单位为 Qt 逻辑像素；跨回调保留对象／索引使用 QPointer / QPersistentModelIndex。
types.en: Positioning and lifecycle context for adapter-owned Popup editing. Rectangles are full unclipped item bounds in Qt logical pixels. Retain objects/indexes across callbacks using QPointer / QPersistentModelIndex.

members.name: binding
members.zh: 本次编辑绑定上下文，默认空上下文。
members.en: Binding context for this edit; initially empty.

members.name: view
members.zh: 发起编辑的视图，初始 nullptr，不转移所有权。
members.en: Requesting view; initially nullptr; no ownership transfer.

members.name: viewport
members.zh: 视图 viewport，初始 nullptr，不转移所有权。
members.en: View viewport; initially nullptr; no ownership transfer.

members.name: viewportRect
members.zh: viewport 坐标中的编辑范围，初始为空。
members.en: Editor bounds in viewport coordinates; initially empty.

members.name: viewRect
members.zh: view 坐标中的编辑范围，初始为空。
members.en: Editor bounds in view coordinates; initially empty.

members.name: globalRect
members.zh: 全局屏幕坐标中的编辑范围，可用于定位 Popup，初始为空。
members.en: Editor bounds in global screen coordinates for Popup placement; initially empty.

members.name: finish
members.zh: 业务确认或取消后调用；可复制延迟调用，过期请求不影响新会话。不提交模型数据，默认未设置。
members.en: Call after business confirmation or dismissal. Safe to copy and call later; stale requests cannot end newer sessions. Does not commit data; initially unset.

types.name: ItemPane
types.zh: 纵向行 pane 的布局结果。首尾行号为包含边界的布局序号；具体视图是否支持冻结行需查其能力约束。
types.en: Vertical row-pane layout result. Row indexes are inclusive layout indexes; consult view capabilities for frozen-row support.

members.name: type
members.zh: pane 类型，默认 Type::Scrollable。
members.en: Pane type; defaults to Type::Scrollable.

members.name: viewportRect
members.zh: viewport 中的 pane 范围，初始为空。
members.en: Pane bounds in viewport coordinates; initially empty.

members.name: firstRow
members.zh: 首行布局序号，初始 -1。
members.en: First layout row; initially -1.

members.name: lastRow
members.zh: 末行布局序号，包含该行，初始 -1。
members.en: Last layout row, inclusive; initially -1.

types.name: MaterializedItem
types.zh: 已物化项和控件记录。使用持久索引标识项，不要把 row() 缓存为长期身份；控件由框架管理。
types.en: Materialized item/widget record. Use the persistent index as identity, not a cached row(). The framework manages the widget.

members.name: index
members.zh: 持久模型索引，初始无效。
members.en: Persistent model index; initially invalid.

members.name: widget
members.zh: 已物化控件，初始 nullptr。
members.en: Materialized widget; initially nullptr.

members.name: type
members.zh: 回收池控件类型，默认 kDefaultWidgetType（0）。
members.en: Recycler widget type; defaults to kDefaultWidgetType (0).

members.name: geometry
members.zh: viewport 坐标中的项范围，初始为空；保留项可位于屏幕外。
members.en: Item bounds in viewport coordinates; initially empty; pinned items may be offscreen.

members.name: pinned
members.zh: 是否因焦点、IME、Popup 或显式请求而保留，初始 false。
members.en: Whether retained for focus, IME, Popup or explicit pinning; initially false.

types.name: TablePaneSpec
types.zh: 显式列 pane 配置。只指定列归属和滚动方式，列宽、隐藏和顺序仍由 HeaderGeometry 管理。
types.en: Explicit column-pane configuration. Defines membership and scrolling; HeaderGeometry still owns widths, visibility and order.

members.name: logicalColumns
members.zh: 所属逻辑列号，按视觉顺序显示，初始为空。
members.en: Member logical columns, displayed in visual order; initially empty.

members.name: scroll
members.zh: 滚动方式，默认 PaneScroll::Scrollable。
members.en: Scroll behavior; defaults to PaneScroll::Scrollable.

members.name: scrollGroup
members.zh: 共享横向偏移的组号，默认 0；冻结 pane 忽略。
members.en: Group sharing a horizontal offset; defaults to 0; ignored by frozen panes.

types.name: TablePane
types.zh: 横向 pane 的布局结果。业务配置用 TablePaneSpec 或冻结列接口；此结构不保存独立列宽。
types.en: Horizontal pane layout result. Configure through TablePaneSpec or frozen-column APIs; this structure does not own column widths.

members.name: type
members.zh: pane 类型，默认 Type::Scrollable。
members.en: Pane type; defaults to Type::Scrollable.

members.name: scrollGroup
members.zh: 横向滚动组，初始 -1；冻结 pane 使用 -1。
members.en: Horizontal scroll group; initially -1, also used by frozen panes.

members.name: viewportRect
members.zh: viewport 中的 pane 矩形，初始为空。
members.en: Pane rectangle in viewport coordinates; initially empty.

members.name: logicalColumns
members.zh: 按视觉顺序排列的可见逻辑列，不含隐藏列，初始为空。
members.en: Visible logical columns in visual order, excluding hidden columns; initially empty.

types.name: TableSpan
types.zh: 从锚点开始的矩形合并尺寸，锚点由查询或 setSpan() 索引指定。默认 1×1 表示未合并。
types.en: Rectangular span size starting at the anchor supplied by a query or setSpan(). Defaults to 1 by 1, meaning unmerged.

members.name: rowSpan
members.zh: 包含的行数，默认 1。
members.en: Number of covered rows; defaults to 1.

members.name: columnSpan
members.zh: 包含的列数，默认 1。
members.en: Number of covered columns; defaults to 1.

types.name: DragOptions
types.zh: 手动 startDrag() 的预览与热点选项。默认使用视图生成的预览，并以按下位置作为热点。
types.en: Preview and hotspot options for manual startDrag(). Defaults to a view-generated preview anchored at the press position.

members.name: previewWidget
members.zh: 截图来源控件，默认 nullptr 使用视图默认来源；不转移所有权。
members.en: Capture source; nullptr uses the view default; no ownership transfer.

members.name: previewRect
members.zh: 来源控件局部截图范围，默认空矩形使用默认预览或完整指定控件；非空范围裁剪到控件边界。
members.en: Widget-local capture bounds; empty uses the default preview or whole explicit widget; nonempty bounds are clipped to the widget.

members.name: usePressPosition
members.zh: 使用鼠标位置作为热点，默认 true；false 时居中。
members.en: Anchor at the pointer; defaults to true; false centers the preview.

members.name: globalPressPosition
members.zh: 可选全局按下位置，默认未提供，回退到匹配按下记录或当前光标；(0,0) 也是有效显式值。
members.en: Optional global press position; absent by default, falling back to a matching press or current cursor; (0,0) is valid.

types.name: ItemBindingContext
types.zh: 绑定／编辑回调的项数据与布局元信息。index 标识当前项；rowData 按 itemDataRole() 从规范列读取，表格通常为第 0 列。
types.en: Item data and layout metadata for binding/editing callbacks. index identifies the item; rowData is read with itemDataRole() from the canonical column, normally column 0 for tables.

members.name: index
members.zh: 当前项或单元格索引，默认无效。
members.en: Current item/cell index; initially invalid.

members.name: rowData
members.zh: 整行／节点业务数据，默认无效 QVariant。
members.en: Row/node payload; initially an invalid QVariant.

members.name: logicalColumn
members.zh: 表格逻辑列号；列表／树为 -1，默认 -1。
members.en: Logical table column; -1 for lists/trees; initially -1.

members.name: depth
members.zh: 相对显示根的深度；平面项为 0，默认 -1。
members.en: Depth relative to the displayed root; 0 for flat items; initially -1.

members.name: indentationWidth
members.zh: 未裁剪的祖先缩进宽度，默认 0；非树项和树表非第 0 列为 0。
members.en: Unclipped ancestor indentation width; initially 0; 0 for non-tree items and nonzero tree-table columns.

members.name: branchWidth
members.zh: 节点自身 branch 格宽度，不是图标大小；默认 0，仅隐藏图标仍保留此宽度。
members.en: Node branch-cell width, not icon size; initially 0; hiding only the icon retains the width.

types.name: PaneSeparatorStyle
types.zh: 冻结行／列边界样式，与普通分割线分别配置。默认 1 物理像素实线，颜色跟随样式分割线。
types.en: Frozen row/column boundary style, independent of ordinary grid lines. Defaults to a 1-physical-pixel solid stroke using the style separator color.

members.name: width
members.zh: 线宽默认 1；0 隐藏边界线。
members.en: Stroke width defaults to 1; 0 hides the separator.

members.name: color
members.zh: 显式颜色，默认无效 QColor 时跟随样式。
members.en: Explicit color; initially invalid QColor, using the style color.

members.name: lineStyle
members.zh: 线型，默认 Qt::SolidLine，可配置虚线。
members.en: Pen style; defaults to Qt::SolidLine; supports dashed lines.

types.name: VisibleRange
types.zh: 包含首尾的项序号区间。默认 first=last=-1 表示无效／空区间。
types.en: Inclusive item-index range. Initially first=last=-1 denotes an invalid/empty range.

members.name: first
members.zh: 第一个项序号，初始 -1。
members.en: First item index; initially -1.

members.name: last
members.zh: 最后一个项序号（包含），初始 -1。
members.en: Last item index, inclusive; initially -1.

types.name: VirtualViewStats
types.zh: 虚拟化状态及累计操作快照，用于观察复用。当前数量与累计次数不同，字段初始均为 0。
types.en: Snapshot of virtualization state and cumulative operations for observing reuse. Current counts differ from lifetime totals; all fields initially are 0.

members.name: logicalItems
members.zh: 逻辑项数量。
members.en: Logical item count.

members.name: materializedItems
members.zh: 当前拥有 QWidget 的项数量。
members.en: Current items owning QWidgets.

members.name: pooledWidgets
members.zh: 当前在回收池等待复用的控件数。
members.en: Widgets currently awaiting reuse in pools.

members.name: pinnedWidgets
members.zh: 因焦点、输入、Popup 或显式请求而保留的控件数。
members.en: Widgets retained for focus, input, Popup or explicit pinning.

members.name: createCount
members.zh: 视图创建以来回收器创建控件的累计次数。
members.en: Cumulative recycler widget creations since view construction.

members.name: bindCount
members.zh: 已完成行／单元格绑定的累计次数，包含重新绑定。
members.en: Cumulative completed row/cell bindings, including rebindings.

members.name: recycleCount
members.zh: 控件返回回收池的累计次数。
members.en: Cumulative widget returns to recycler pools.

types.name: ScrollAnchor
types.zh: 持久索引和项内偏移构成的滚动锚点，用于数据变化后恢复位置。默认无效索引、0 偏移。
types.en: Scroll anchor formed by a persistent index and intra-item offset for restoring position after data changes. Initially invalid with zero offset.

members.name: index
members.zh: 锚点持久索引，删除该项后失效。
members.en: Persistent anchor index; invalidated when the item is removed.

members.name: offsetInsideItem
members.zh: viewport 顶部在锚点项内的纵向偏移，默认 0。
members.en: Vertical offset of the viewport top inside the anchor item; defaults to 0.

types.name: VirtualItemView::VisualState
types.zh: 项的目标 hover/selection 状态与当前动画进度。布尔值描述目标，进度用于平滑绘制，动画期间可尚未到达目标。
types.en: Target hover/selection state and current animation progress. Booleans describe targets; progress drives smooth painting and may still be transitioning.

members.name: hovered
members.zh: hover 目标状态，默认 false。
members.en: Target hover state; defaults to false.

members.name: selected
members.zh: 选中目标状态，默认 false。
members.en: Target selected state; defaults to false.

members.name: hoverProgress
members.zh: hover 绘制进度 0～1，默认 0。
members.en: Hover progress in [0,1]; defaults to 0.

members.name: selectedProgress
members.zh: 选中绘制进度 0～1，默认 0。
members.en: Selection progress in [0,1]; defaults to 0.

types.name: VirtualItemView::DropTarget
types.zh: 拖放命中结果。插入 row/column 是 parent 下的模型坐标，不是展开后的可见行号；ontoItem 表示放入项内。有效位置仍需通过模型 canDropMimeData()/dropMimeData() 的限制。
types.en: Resolved drop target. Insertion row/column are model coordinates under parent, not flattened visible row numbers. ontoItem means dropping into an item. Valid locations still require model canDropMimeData()/dropMimeData() approval.

members.name: parent
members.zh: 插入父索引；ontoItem 时表示目标项。默认无效，插入时通常代表根层级。
members.en: Insertion parent, or destination item for ontoItem. Initially invalid, normally meaning root-level insertion.

members.name: row
members.zh: 父项下的插入行，默认 -1；单元格内部放置可为 -1。
members.en: Insertion row under parent; initially -1; cell drops may use -1.

members.name: column
members.zh: 模型列位置，默认 -1，需结合 row、cellDrop、ontoItem 解释。
members.en: Model column position; initially -1; interpret with row, cellDrop and ontoItem.

members.name: ontoItem
members.zh: 放到 parent 表示的节点／单元格内而非行间，默认 false。
members.en: Drop into the node/cell represented by parent rather than between rows; defaults to false.

members.name: trailing
members.zh: 命中末项下方空白；指示器标记内容尾部，row 为父项末尾插入位置，默认 false。
members.en: Hit space below the last item; indicator marks content end and row is insertion after the parent's last child; defaults to false.

members.name: cellDrop
members.zh: 载荷为单元格而非整行，默认 false；相邻插入不一定移除源行。
members.en: Cell payload rather than a whole row; defaults to false; adjacent insertion need not remove the source row.

members.name: isValid
members.zh: row≥0，或 cellDrop、ontoItem 均为 true、parent 有效且 row/column 均为 -1 时有效。只检查位置，不检查模型权限。
members.en: True for row>=0, or cellDrop and ontoItem with valid parent and row/column both -1. Checks location, not model permission.

types.name: GridLinePlacement
types.zh: 项间距中的分割线位置。零间距时只使用一个共享边界；支持范围需看具体视图。
types.en: Grid-line placement inside gaps. Zero spacing uses a single shared boundary; support depends on the view.

members.name: SpacingCenter
members.zh: 间距中心画线，始终穿过另一方向间距；外侧补半间距居中。
members.en: Draw at gap centers, always crossing perpendicular gaps; outer half-gaps center content.

members.name: SpacingEdges
members.zh: 间距两侧画线，支持的视图可配置是否跨过另一方向间距。
members.en: Draw at both gap edges; supporting views can configure perpendicular-gap crossing.

types.name: EditTrigger
types.zh: 自动编辑手势标志，用 EditTriggers 按位或组合。显式 edit(index) 独立于标志，模型仍须允许编辑。
types.en: Automatic editing flags, combined through EditTriggers. Explicit edit(index) is independent; model permission still applies.

members.name: NoEditTriggers
members.zh: 0：关闭自动手势，仍允许显式 edit()。
members.en: 0: disable automatic gestures, retaining explicit edit().

members.name: SingleClicked
members.zh: 0x1：单击编辑。
members.en: 0x1: single-click editing.

members.name: DoubleClicked
members.zh: 0x2：双击编辑。
members.en: 0x2: double-click editing.

members.name: EditKeyPressed
members.zh: 0x4：编辑键 F2 触发。
members.en: 0x4: editing via F2.

types.name: HeaderGeometry::ResizeMode
types.zh: 底层 section 尺寸策略。表格业务通常用 setColumnResizeMode()；FitExtent 捕获比例并清除普通拉伸设置。
types.en: Low-level section-sizing strategy. Table applications normally use setColumnResizeMode(); FitExtent captures proportions and clears ordinary stretching.

members.name: Independent
members.zh: 独立尺寸及普通拉伸策略，默认模式。
members.en: Independent sizes and ordinary stretching; the default.

members.name: FitExtent
members.zh: 尺寸加间距匹配可用长度，拖动按快照比例分摊；极端长度下放宽限制。
members.en: Fit sizes plus gaps to available extent; distribute drags by snapshot proportions, relaxing limits at extremes.

types.name: ItemPane::Type
types.zh: 纵向 pane 的位置和滚动方式。
types.en: Position and scrolling of a vertical pane.

members.name: FrozenTop
members.zh: 顶部冻结行。
members.en: Top frozen rows.

members.name: Scrollable
members.zh: 跟随纵向偏移，ItemPane 默认值。
members.en: Follow vertical offsets; the ItemPane default.

members.name: FrozenBottom
members.zh: 底部冻结行。
members.en: Bottom frozen rows.

types.name: PaneScroll
types.zh: 显式 TablePaneSpec 的横向滚动方式。
types.en: Horizontal scrolling for an explicit TablePaneSpec.

members.name: Frozen
members.zh: 冻结，不随横向偏移移动。
members.en: Frozen; does not follow horizontal offsets.

members.name: Scrollable
members.zh: 跟随 scrollGroup 偏移，TablePaneSpec 默认值。
members.en: Follow scrollGroup offsets; the TablePaneSpec default.

types.name: TablePane::Type
types.zh: 横向 pane 布局类型。
types.en: Horizontal pane layout type.

members.name: FrozenLeft
members.zh: 左侧冻结 pane。
members.en: Left frozen pane.

members.name: Scrollable
members.zh: 随所属组横向滚动，默认值。
members.en: Scroll horizontally with its group; the default.

members.name: FrozenRight
members.zh: 右侧冻结 pane。
members.en: Right frozen pane.

types.name: VirtualFlowTableView::CellHeightMode
types.zh: Flow 网格高度策略，使用专用 cell 尺寸接口配置。
types.en: Flow grid height strategy, configured with dedicated cell-size APIs.

members.name: Fixed
members.zh: 使用 setCellHeight() 的统一高度。
members.en: Use the uniform setCellHeight() value.

members.name: AspectRatio
members.zh: 按实际 cell 宽度和 setCellAspectRatio() 的宽／高比计算。
members.en: Compute from actual cell width and the setCellAspectRatio() width/height ratio.

types.name: VirtualItemView::ScrollHint
types.zh: scrollTo() 定位策略，最终位置受实际滚动范围约束。
types.en: scrollTo() positioning hint; final position is clamped to the available scroll range.

members.name: EnsureVisible
members.zh: 仅在必要时滚动使目标可见。
members.en: Scroll only as needed to expose the target.

members.name: PositionAtTop
members.zh: 尽量定位到可滚动区域顶部。
members.en: Position at the top of the scrolling area where possible.

members.name: PositionAtBottom
members.zh: 尽量定位到可滚动区域底部。
members.en: Position at the bottom of the scrolling area where possible.

members.name: PositionAtCenter
members.zh: 尽量定位到可滚动区域中心。
members.en: Center in the scrolling area where possible.

types.name: VirtualItemView::SelectionMode
types.zh: 用户选择手势模式，不限制 selectionModel() 的显式批量选择；选择单元由 SelectionBehavior 决定。
types.en: User selection gestures, not a restriction on explicit batch selection through selectionModel(). SelectionBehavior defines the unit.

members.name: NoSelection
members.zh: 用户手势不改变选择。
members.en: User gestures do not change selection.

members.name: SingleSelection
members.zh: 用户交互只保留一个选择项。
members.en: User interaction keeps one selected item.

members.name: MultiSelection
members.zh: 单击切换选中，允许多项。
members.en: Clicks toggle selection, allowing multiple items.

members.name: ExtendedSelection
members.zh: 普通点击、Ctrl 切换、Shift 范围选择；默认模式。
members.en: Ordinary clicks, Ctrl toggles and Shift ranges; the default.

types.name: VirtualItemView::SelectionBehavior
types.zh: 选择和内置 hover/selection 绘制范围。表格支持按格和按行。
types.en: Selection unit and built-in hover/selection extent. Tables support cells and rows.

members.name: SelectItems
members.zh: 表格按单元格选择和绘制状态。
members.en: Select and paint state per table cell.

members.name: SelectRows
members.zh: 整行选择和绘制状态，默认值。
members.en: Select and paint state across the row; the default.

types.name: VirtualItemView::DropIndicatorStyle
types.zh: 拖放指示器形状，与 DragFeedbackMode 不同；命中位置也决定使用插入线还是目标框。
types.en: Drop-indicator shape, distinct from DragFeedbackMode; resolved locations also determine insertion lines versus target frames.

members.name: Line
members.zh: 项之间的插入线，使用配置线宽和颜色。
members.en: Insertion line using configured width and color.

members.name: Frame
members.zh: 接收放置项的描边框。
members.en: Outline around the receiving item.

types.name: VirtualItemView::DragStartMode
types.zh: 起拖入口；均需模型支持相应 flags、MIME 和 drop 行为。
types.en: Drag-start strategy; both require corresponding model flags, MIME and drop behavior.

members.name: Automatic
members.zh: 按下并移动超过拖动阈值后由视图起拖。
members.en: The view starts dragging after movement exceeds the press threshold.

members.name: Manual
members.zh: 业务按钮或处理器显式调用 startDrag()。
members.en: Business buttons/handlers explicitly call startDrag().

types.name: VirtualItemView::WheelScrollMode
types.zh: 滚轮步进单位，与滚动条策略和外层事件转发分别配置。
types.en: Wheel-step unit, separate from scrollbar policy and outward event forwarding.

members.name: Pixels
members.zh: 按像素距离滚动。
members.en: Scroll by pixel distance.

members.name: Items
members.zh: 按项步进滚动。
members.en: Scroll in item steps.

types.name: VirtualItemView::ItemHeightMode
types.zh: 内核行布局高度策略；Flow、Masonry、Wrap 使用专用尺寸接口。
types.en: Kernel row-layout height strategy; Flow, Masonry and Wrap use dedicated sizing APIs.

members.name: Uniform
members.zh: 所有项统一高度。
members.en: All items share one height.

members.name: Variable
members.zh: 不同项可有不同高度，配合估算、显式高度和测量。
members.en: Allow varying heights with estimates, explicit sizes and measurement.

types.name: VirtualListView::DragFeedbackMode
types.zh: 拖放位置的视觉反馈，最终数据移动由模型负责。
types.en: Visual drop-location feedback; the model performs the final data move.

members.name: Indicator
members.zh: 显示插入线或目标框，不让周围项移动。
members.en: Show an insertion line or target frame without moving surrounding items.

members.name: RowMoveAnimation
members.zh: 周围行移动让出单行占位；结束后完成或恢复布局。
members.en: Move surrounding rows to create a one-row placeholder, completing or restoring layout afterward.

types.name: VirtualTableView::DragFeedbackMode
types.zh: 拖放位置的视觉反馈，最终数据移动由模型负责。
types.en: Visual drop-location feedback; the model performs the final data move.

members.name: Indicator
members.zh: 显示插入线或目标框，不让周围项移动。
members.en: Show an insertion line or target frame without moving surrounding items.

members.name: RowMoveAnimation
members.zh: 周围行移动让出单行占位；结束后完成或恢复布局。
members.en: Move surrounding rows to create a one-row placeholder, completing or restoring layout afterward.

types.name: VirtualTreeView::DragFeedbackMode
types.zh: 拖放位置的视觉反馈，最终数据移动由模型负责。
types.en: Visual drop-location feedback; the model performs the final data move.

members.name: Indicator
members.zh: 显示插入线或目标框，不让周围项移动。
members.en: Show an insertion line or target frame without moving surrounding items.

members.name: RowMoveAnimation
members.zh: 周围行移动让出单行占位；结束后完成或恢复布局。
members.en: Move surrounding rows to create a one-row placeholder, completing or restoring layout afterward.

types.name: VirtualListView::VisualStateBackgroundExtent
types.zh: 列表状态背景和命中范围，可进一步配合背景边距和固定高度，不改变控件大小。
types.en: List state-background and hit extent; may be further limited by margins/height without resizing widgets.

members.name: FullWidth
members.zh: 整行可用宽度。
members.en: Full available row width.

members.name: WidgetOnly
members.zh: 项控件实际宽度。
members.en: Actual item-widget width.

types.name: VirtualMasonryView::ItemHeightMode
types.zh: 瀑布流高度策略。固定／等比例高度且大量项目时，可优先考虑 Flow 规则网格。
types.en: Masonry height strategy. For many fixed/equal-aspect items, consider the Flow regular grid.

members.name: Fixed
members.zh: 统一固定高度。
members.en: Uniform fixed height.

members.name: AspectRatio
members.zh: 由列宽和宽／高比计算高度。
members.en: Compute height from column width and width/height ratio.

members.name: AdapterEstimate
members.zh: adapter 估算各项高度，允许高低不一。
members.en: Adapter estimates individual, potentially different heights.

types.name: VirtualTableView::RowSizePolicy
types.zh: 显式行高与测量高度冲突时的优先级，配合行高模式和自动测量使用。
types.en: Priority between explicit and measured row heights, used with height mode and automatic measurement.

members.name: ExplicitWins
members.zh: 显式或拖动行高优先，测量不覆盖。
members.en: Explicit/manually resized height wins over measurement.

members.name: MeasuredWins
members.zh: 测量结果优先，可覆盖显式行高。
members.en: Measured results win and may replace explicit height.

types.name: VirtualTableView::MaterializationMode
types.zh: 表格物化控件粒度，不决定按行还是按格选择；adapter 需支持对应回调。
types.en: Table widget granularity, independent of selection unit; the adapter must support matching callbacks.

members.name: RowWidgets
members.zh: 每物化行一个 QWidget 承载各列，默认模式。
members.en: One QWidget per materialized row containing its columns; the default.

members.name: CellWidgets
members.zh: 每物化单元格一个 QWidget，数量随行列窗口增加。
members.en: One QWidget per materialized cell; count grows with the row/column window.

types.name: VirtualTableView::DropTargetMode
types.zh: SelectItems 下的放置规则；SelectRows 始终行间插入，TreeTable 使用层级节点规则。
types.en: Drop rules under SelectItems; SelectRows inserts between rows, while TreeTable uses hierarchical rules.

members.name: BetweenRows
members.zh: 仅行间插入。
members.en: Insertion between rows only.

members.name: OnCell
members.zh: 放到单元格内部。
members.en: Drop onto a cell.

members.name: BetweenRowsOrOnCell
members.zh: 根据命中位置区分行间和单元格内部。
members.en: Distinguish row insertion and cell drops by pointer location.

types.name: VirtualTableView::ColumnResizeMode
types.zh: 列宽与可用宽度的关系；普通拉伸比例和 FitViewport 是不同策略，后者接管宽度分配。
types.en: Column sizing relative to available width; ordinary stretching differs from FitViewport, which takes over allocation.

members.name: Independent
members.zh: 独立列宽和普通比例拉伸；设置或拖动列宽清除普通比例限制，默认模式。
members.en: Independent widths and ordinary stretch factors; setting/dragging widths clears factors; the default.

members.name: FitViewport
members.zh: 可见列宽加间距匹配 viewport；边界拖动由对应一侧列按比例分摊，极端宽度放宽限制。
members.en: Fit visible widths plus gaps to viewport; edge drags redistribute proportionally on that side, relaxing limits at extremes.

types.name: VirtualTableView::MoveAnimation
types.zh: 程序 moveColumn() 的表头过渡选项。几何顺序立即提交，动画只影响支持的表头渲染器。
types.en: Header transition for programmatic moveColumn(). Geometry order commits immediately; animation affects supporting renderers only.

members.name: Immediate
members.zh: 立即显示最终顺序，默认值。
members.en: Show final order immediately; the default.

members.name: Animate
members.zh: 请求表头位置动画；不支持的原生表头忽略。
members.en: Request header movement animation; unsupported native headers ignore it.

types.name: VirtualTreeView::RowGridLineExtent
types.zh: 树行分割线范围，以边界上方节点为依据；TreeTable 不使用该模式配置。
types.en: Tree separator extent based on the node above the boundary; TreeTable does not use this mode setting.

members.name: NodeOnly
members.zh: 从内容起点向右，不覆盖 branch 和祖先缩进。
members.en: Rightward from node content, excluding branch and ancestor indentation.

members.name: NodeAndIcon
members.zh: 包含自身 branch 图标区域，无图标或隐藏时回退 NodeOnly。
members.en: Include the node branch-icon area; use NodeOnly if absent or hidden.

members.name: FullWidth
members.zh: 整行宽度，包含缩进。
members.en: Full row width including indentation.

types.name: VirtualTreeView::VisualStateBackgroundExtent
types.zh: 树状态背景与命中范围，可配合背景高度和边距；独立 branch 点击不受状态裁剪影响。TreeTable 固定使用表格行规则。
types.en: Tree state-background and hit extent, combinable with state height/margins. Independent branch clicks are unaffected. TreeTable uses its table-row rules.

members.name: NodeOnly
members.zh: 节点内容起点到行右边缘。
members.en: Node content start to row right edge.

members.name: NodeAndIcon
members.zh: 自身 branch 图标区域到行右边缘；无图标或隐藏时用 NodeOnly。
members.en: Branch-icon area to row right edge; use NodeOnly if absent or hidden.

members.name: FullWidth
members.zh: 整行范围，包含祖先缩进。
members.en: Full row including ancestor indentation.

members.name: WidgetOnly
members.zh: 实际项控件范围。
members.en: Actual item-widget bounds.

members.name: WidgetAndIcon
members.zh: 实际控件及自身 branch 图标区域；无图标或隐藏时用 WidgetOnly。
members.en: Actual widget plus branch-icon area; use WidgetOnly if absent or hidden.
